name: io.github.chomkaevan/public-domain-check
title: Public Domain Check
description: Is a book, film, song or artwork in the US public domain, and when? Pay per call via x402.

environmentVariables.name: WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a wallet holding a little USDC on Base; pays a few cents per paid call. Free tools work without it.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_PRICE_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Hard cap in USD per call (default 0.25)
